title: The bill nobody capped
scenario:
You are the budget owner for AI tools at a 60-person logistics company. The ops team (25 people) uses Claude on a Team plan with usage credits turned on. The rest of the company is piloting a ChatGPT Enterprise workspace on a credit-based agreement that allows overage. Finance sends you four notes before the next quarter.

Use the exhibit. The company, people and amounts are made up for this case. Product facts are from the vendors' help pages in October 2026.
exhibit:
FINANCE NOTES (made up)

  1. ChatGPT: "We set a usage alert at $500 for
     overage, so overage can never go above $500."

  2. ChatGPT: Ana is in two groups. Marketing has a
     monthly user limit of 200 credits, Analysts has
     800. She has no personal override.
     "Which limit does Ana get?"

  3. Claude: "Sam hit his usage limit on Tuesday.
     Is the whole ops team blocked until reset?"

  4. Claude: "Usage credits: org spend limit is set
     to Unlimited. We want extra usage to stop at
     about $400 a month for the whole team."

questions.prompt: Note 1: is finance right about the $500 alert?

options.text: Yes, an alert stops all overage once it reaches the set amount
options.explanation: OpenAI: alerts notify; they don't stop spending.

options.text: Yes, but only when the alert is sent to a workspace owner
options.explanation: Who gets the alert does not matter. An alert never stops spending.

options.text: No, alerts only notify; set the workspace overage limit too
options.explanation: Right. OpenAI: alerts notify; they don't stop spending. The overage limit controls use after the credits run out.

options.text: No, overage can't be limited at all on a credit agreement
options.explanation: The ChatGPT docs describe a workspace overage limit, and say a limit of zero prevents overage.

questions.prompt: Note 2: which monthly limit applies to Ana?

options.text: 200 credits, because the lowest group limit always wins
options.explanation: The ChatGPT docs say the opposite: the highest applicable group limit applies.

options.text: 800 credits, because the highest group limit applies
options.explanation: Right. OpenAI: when a person belongs to more than one group, the highest applicable group limit applies.

options.text: 1,000 credits, because her two group limits are added up
options.explanation: Group limits are not added. The highest one applies.

options.text: No limit, because members of two groups have no cap at all
options.explanation: Belonging to two groups does not remove the limit. The highest group limit applies.

questions.prompt: Note 3: what happens to the rest of the ops team?

options.text: Everyone is blocked, since the team shares one usage limit
options.explanation: The Claude Help Center says Team plan usage limits are per member, not for the team as a whole.

options.text: Everyone is slowed down until Sam's limit resets next week
options.explanation: No page says that. Each member has their own limit.

options.text: The others are blocked only in Claude Code, not in chat
options.explanation: The Claude Help Center says all Claude products count toward one limit per person, and each person has their own.

options.text: They keep working, since each member has their own limit
options.explanation: Right. Anthropic: Team plan usage limits are per member. One member at the limit does not block the others.

questions.prompt: Note 4: how do you make extra usage stop near $400 a month?

options.text: Set the org-wide monthly spend limit for usage credits to $400
options.explanation: Right. Anthropic: Owners can set a monthly spend limit on the whole organization's usage credits. Spend can go slightly over it.

options.text: Remove five members, so the plan pays for fewer seats at once
options.explanation: Removing members gives no refund and does not cap usage credits.

options.text: Leave it on Unlimited, since Team plans cap credits at $400
options.explanation: No page gives such a cap. Unlimited means no organization-wide limit.

options.text: Ask members to stop at $400 in a message to the whole team
options.explanation: A message is not a cap. Anthropic gives Owners an organization-wide spend limit.
